about: Dated occasion calendar for the ReadSigil homepage band. Dates are India Standard Time and inclusive. Sources: Government of India lists of gazetted (Annexure-I) and restricted (Annexure-II) holidays for central government offices, Delhi/New Delhi, 2026 and 2027. Lunar dates marked tentative follow moon sighting: confirm and edit the day before.
policy: Mark occasions across communities with equal weight and the same restrained format: one sentence, no imagery.
Days of mourning or remembrance (Good Friday, Muharram, martyrdom days) get no greeting.
Every entry expires on its end date; nothing stays up by default.
Add an entry only with a verified date and source.
